title: Mixcity Swap is an upcoming card battler that promises you it's the anti gacha
summary: Whenever I mention that I write about mobile gaming, the inevitable first response from laymen and industry people alike is, 'Well, that's all just gacha, right?' And on the one hand, they're not necessarily right, but not wrong either. The random draw system is so pervasive that even many developers pit themselves against it, like with the upcoming Mixcity Swap. Positioning itself as the anti-gacha, Mixcity Swap is an upcoming sports-themed card battler by Atypique Studio, releasing in 2027 for iOS and Android, that sees you taking on fast-paced, 10-minute matches. With only nine cards on the roster, the gameplay revolves around swapping in and out your athletes across different modes, doing so at the right interval as they activate their individual effects. ... [MORE]

title: Cell to Singularity's Future update takes you into space for a new look at humanity's progress
summary: There's an odd fascination amongst developers for trying to simulate the progression of humanity. Surviving Mars, Alpha Centauri and, of course, Civilization. But in Cell to Singularity, developer Computer Lunch has been working towards a simulation of everything, with the latest major step being their Future update. Cell to Singularity is, essentially, exactly what it says on the tin. Your goal is to explore and guide a simulation of an entire human civilisation, starting from simple single-celled organisms all the way up to the space-faring apes we all know and love. And the Future expansion, naturally, takes you into the speculative future of space travel and beyond. ... [MORE]

title: Postal Classic & Uncut brings the dark, violent classic shooter to Android
summary: There are plenty of controversial game franchises out there. But many are pretty lazy, and either intentionally racist, sexist or simply provocative. A truly controversial series is one that sets out to do something, and does so in an unapologetic and probably disturbing way. In unrelated news, Running With Scissors' Postal Classic & Uncut is out now on Google Play! Unlike, say, Postal II, there's no wackiness or crass humour here. The story is simple: You are the Dude, and everybody else has to die. That means blasting your way through dozens of levels ranging from suburban neighbourhoods to downtown metropolises, with a variety of firearms and explosives, as you face down police officers, armed residents and plenty of unarmed civilians caught in the crossfire. ... [MORE]

summary: It seems as though it's been a while since we wrote about the Epic Games Store on mobile. But in the background, the House of Sweeney has been quietly chugging along with its free game promotions. And the latest freebie on the Epic Games Store is none other than cosy, no-combat life sim Lonesome Village! In Lonesome Village, you play a lone coyote visiting the titular place, which is now bereft of its inhabitants. A magical tower rising above the village has trapped the residents, and it's up to you to journey through the tower, solving puzzles and freeing more people to rejoin the Lonesome Village. ... title: Leingham Tavern Story has you turning dungeon crawling into a restaurant business
summary: In an RPG, you’d expect to become stronger by hitting things, but in Kemco’s latest, you do it by eating your own cooking (abs are made in the kitchen, as the saying goes). Leingham Tavern Story: Alan and the Time Goddess is out now on the App Store and Google Play. It’s a dungeon crawler and a restaurant sim at the same time, and there’s an orphanage to save on top. That orphanage is the whole reason you’re doing any of this. It’s about to close down, and Alan and his mates reckon a busy tavern will make enough money to keep it going. Which means heading down into dungeons for ingredients. ... [MORE]

title: Monopoly Go introduces a new cooperative minigame that lets you and your friends build Paths
summary: Whether you like it or loathe it, there's no doubting the popularity and staying power of Monopoly Go for Scopely. Now, the hit tabletop-to-mobile adaptation is receiving an all-new minigame. Paths challenge you to think cooperatively, or look out for yourself, and debut today with the launch of the new Franken Paths as part of the Monster Mash season! Paths are a straightforward cooperative minigame where you and up to three other tycoons team up to build a path and move a shared vehicle along it. You'll accumulate points and have the choice to either use them to build your assigned portion (and reap the rewards) or send them to another player, with the aim of reaching the end together and getting even greater goodies. ... [MORE]

title: Talking Tom Gold Run raises the stakes in new all-or-nothing Extraction Mode
summary: It's all or nothing in Outfit7's latest update for Talking Tom Gold Run, where the concept of "high risk, high return" has never been truer! In particular, a new Extraction Mode within the endless runner tasks you with running faster and faster for better and better rewards - the catch is that when you crash and burn, so does your hard-earned haul. The limited-time event not only challenges your quick reflexes but also your prudence - do you go for the bigger pay-off or leave while you can with what you already have? There are three chances for you to tap out, and once you reach each extraction point, you get to choose whether or not you want to stick around. ... [MORE]

title: Dicevaders is a roguelike dice-roller about overwhelming Earth's defences, coming to mobile
summary: Time to defend the Earth! Wait, no. In today's game, you're doing anything except saving the planet! Because this time around, in this follow-up to Starvaders, you play not as the saviours, but the Dicevaders, as this roguelike dice roller is set to arrive November 26th on iOS and Android! In Dicevaders, your objective is simple: overwhelm humanity's defences as you hop from planet to planet with the ultimate aim of Earth itself. To do so, you place troops onto the board, play cards and, of course, roll dice. You'll need to synergise your choices to build up combos, while deciding when to deploy your units, nudge the outcome of dice or lock the min place. Think Balatro or Dice of Kalma, mixed with destroying the Earth. ... [MORE]

Think Balatro or Dice of Kalma, mixed with destroying the Earth. ... [MORE]

summary: I was fully expecting a Gen Z word to win the Words With Friends Word of the Year. I’m technically part of that group myself, and I still couldn’t tell you what half of them mean, but that’s where I assumed things were heading. I was going to work a few of them into the opener to show willingness, but Whimsy isn’t really one for that, so that idea’s gone out the window. The community vote ran over email and social media, with Whimsy beating runner-up Iconic in the final round. Iconic doesn’t really do anything for me. Whimsy seems like a good pick, though. ... title: Brown is Bart Bonte's latest colour-themed micro-puzzler, out now on iOS and Android
summary: With so many big, flashy mobile games currently available to play, it can all seem a bit overwhelming. Fortunately, there's still room for fun, experimental stuff to flourish on mobile, as we've seen with solo developer Bart Bonte. Now, the latest in Bonte's series of colour-themed micro-puzzlers has just been released, with the launch of Brown for iOS and Android. If you're not familiar with Bart Bonte's previous entries such as Orange and Purple, then you'll be glad to know things are pretty straightforward. Because, rather than a core mechanic, each of the 50 levels in Bart Bonte's Brown is based around self-contained logic and puzzles, which you'll need to figure out to solve. ... [MORE]

title: Tree of Savior M, the upcoming multiplatform MMORPG from IMC Games, opens pre-registration
summary: Back in the day, the MMORPG was purely the domain of PC players, but now everyone is getting in on the action. And a dark horse candidate that's stood out for many of us is none other than Tree of Savior, IMC Games' upcoming multiplatform MMORPG that's just launched pre-registration! Tree of Savior M is set in a fantasy world where its patron goddess has vanished into the ether. Guided by divine visions, it's up to you to help safeguard the world and its people. During the course of your adventures you'll be assisted not only by the usual suite of upgrades and equipment, but also assisted by recruitable Fellows to help you out, and the pet-like Kupoles! ... [MORE]
